addr.description: IP address or hostname for the NBD server to listen on.

port.description: TCP port number for incoming NBD connections.

threads.description: Number of worker threads to handle I/O requests.

export_name.description: Name of the exported device; clients use this to select which export to connect to.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the export.

export_file.description: Path to the file or block device to export (e.g., /dev/sdb1 or /path/to/disk.img).

export_size.description: Override auto-detected export size (e.g., '1G', '500M'). Leave empty to auto-detect.

read_only.description: If true, clients can only read from the exported device; writes are rejected.

multifile.description: If true, treat export_file as a directory of files to treat as a single logical device (use with caution).

copy_on_write.description: If true, enable copy-on-write mode — writes create a separate overlay instead of modifying the source.

strict_io.description: If true, disable asynchronous I/O for stricter compliance and reduced risk of data corruption (slower).

prealloc.description: Preallocation strategy for sparse files ('none', 'falloc', or 'full'). Leave empty for default behavior.

block_size.description: Override the logical block size (in bytes) advertised to clients (e.g., 512 or 4096). Default uses device-native size.

tls.description: Enable TLS encryption for this export (requires TLS cert/key configuration).

tls_cert.description: Path to the TLS server certificate (PEM format). Required if TLS is enabled.

tls_key.description: Path to the TLS server private key (PEM format, unencrypted). Required if TLS is enabled.

tls_ca_cert.description: Path to the CA certificate for client certificate verification (optional, for mutual TLS).

hosts_allow.description: List of IP addresses, hostnames, or CIDR ranges allowed to connect to this export.

items.description: A single allowed host or subnet (e.g., '192.168.1.0/24' or 'client.example.com').

hosts_deny.description: List of hosts/subnets explicitly denied access to this export.

items.description: A single denied host or subnet (e.g., '10.0.0.5' or '0.0.0.0/0' to deny all).

custom_options.description: Additional low-level options not covered by the above fields (e.g., 'no-tls', 'send_meta', etc.). Each list item is one full line.

items.description: A single raw configuration line to append to this export block.
